title: AiAdvisor
description: How a run may ask a stronger model for advice. Off unless the caller asks; at most 3 uses and at most 100 words of advice come back, and each use is on the run's receipt with its cost. The executor stays in charge: advice is guidance in the run's transcript, never an answer or a tool the advisor runs.

model.description: The stronger model to consult, as provider/model from GET /api/v1/routes. Omitted: the owner's reviewer role default, then the strongest offer the run's route can serve.

effort.description: The advice call's effort. auto is refused: it resolves to a concrete level before the call (high when omitted).

max_uses.description: How many times this run may ask for advice. 1 to 3; the default is 3.

max_words.description: The longest advice the advisor may return. 10 to 100 words; the default is 100 and longer advice is cut to it.
